name: GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited
remarksWeb: 1.During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, GMR Estate Management Private Limited (GEMPL), an entity forming part of the promoter group acquired 7,45,56,604 equity shares of the Company from GMR Enterprises Private Limited (GEPL), a promoter of the Company, by way of an inter-se transfer. The said inter se transfer was between qualified persons, i.e. between GEPL (Holding Company) and GEPML (subsidiary of GEPL) and accordingly, exempted  under  Regulation 10 of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, from the requirement of open offer, after fulfilling the conditions as prescribed in the said regulation. Pursuant to the aforesaid transfer, GEMPL's shareholding in the Company increased to 24.91% with consequential reduction in the shareholding of GEPL to 10.18%.  2.During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, M/s GVL Enterprise Pte Ltd and M/s Yehuda Investment Holdings Limited were incorporated and based on their shareholding structure, have been categorised under the Promoter Group in accordance with Regulation 2(1)(pp) of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018.  3. The shareholding of Synergy Industrials, Metals and Power Holdings Ltd. (Synergy) in the Company exceeded 10% of the equity share capital of the Company (on fully diluted basis). Accordingly, shareholding of  Synergy has been reclassified under the Foreign Direct Investment category.  4.The Company has Corporate Shareholders holding more than 10% shares of the Company i.e. GMR Enterprises Private Limited (GEPL) and GMR Estate Management Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of GEPL. GEPL along with its subsidiaries and affiliates holds approx. 46.28% shares of the Company. The Shareholders of GMR Enterprises Private Limited comprises of Discretionary Trusts with no identified beneficial owners. remarksWeb: 1. None of the shareholders of the Company hold more than 10% shares/voting rights in the Company, except the holding company viz. GMR Enterprises Private Limited (GEPL), which through itself and other subsidiary companies, holds 50.29% of the paid-up equity share capital of the Company. Accordingly, the provisions of the Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners) Rules, 2018 does not apply to the Company, except for intimation of Corporate Identification Number of GEPL in e-form BEN-2 with Ministry of Corporate Affairs. Thus, the declaration Whether the listed entity has any significant beneficial owner is marked as No.  2. Number of Shares pledged or otherwise encumbered mentioned in Table I and Table II are only for Promoter & Promoter Group.  4.List of Subsidiaries of the Company (GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited) have also been included in the Promoter Group, to comply with the definiton of Promoter Group as per SEBI (ICDR), Regulations 2018, even while such Subsidiaries cannot hold shares in the Listed holding Company.  5.During the quarter ended September 30, 2025, GMR Vemagiri Power Generation Limited (GVPGL) and GMR Rajahmundry Energy Limited (GREL) which were having nil Shareholding,  have ceased to be the subsidiaries of the Promoter Company, after sale of majority stake in the respective entities held by the Companies within the group to Synergy investment Holdings Limited, consequently, GVPGL and GREL have ceased to be part of the Promoter Group in accordance with Regulation 2(1)(pp) of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, and have not been considered in the promoter group for the current quarter.
